call_guidance.ephemeris_policy: Read guolao.profile.ephemeris_provenance and, when requested, timing.profile.ephemeris_provenance. Seven physical bodies retain actual ecliptic/equatorial models and flags; incompatible frame models are rejected.
call_guidance.longitude_motion: Seven physical bodies expose corrected tropical longitude_speed plus longitude_speed_native and separately reported correction terms.
call_guidance.nobles: Native god_positions uses Lu Wei catalogue bundle vols.1-2 Tianyi day/Yutang night tables, including Wu/Geng same-branch exception. Read the disclosed year-boundary policy.
call_guidance.patterns: Read guolao.moira_patterns rule_id and evidence.inputs/granularity with guolao.bodies, palaces, rulesets and rule_trace. profile.pattern_model_id identifies the selected condition model.
call_guidance.purple: purple_model_audit distinguishes the facsimile printed 365.2564-du table from the author's 365.2575-du reference circle; the modern epoch remains unresolved.
call_guidance.reference_houses: angles, houses and planets.house are astronomical references in the selected zodiac; Lahiri houses use native Swiss sidereal cusps.
call_guidance.scope: guolao_research_v7; source ordinal life-palace counting with declared modern solar-palace/hour/term-endpoint conventions; life degree and mansion unresolved; modern equatorial research anchors;
call_guidance.solar_time: Recorded physical instant remains fixed; optional apparent solar clock determines birth-hour branch and may change life palace and dependent patterns.
call_guidance.target_instant: Only pass analysis_datetime for an explicitly specified target instant with timezone offset, at or after recorded birth. Omission returns timing.status=not_requested.

astronomy.purpose: 检查时间尺度、七政两帧模型与黄经速度分项、非物理点、距星地球观测者及研究宿度；来源和修正状态不作全域精度认证

classical.purpose: 核对宫主度主归属与未验收依赖

patterns.purpose: 核对政余格局的具名条件、参与星体和计算证据

timing.purpose: 显式analysis_datetime的小限逆数及当时十一曜研究位置；未给目标则not_requested，不据此生成完整流年或现实事件概率

input.description: Explicit target instant for the partial Guolao temporal research layer.

analysis_datetime.description: Optional ISO target instant with timezone offset, at or after recorded birth. Returns source-ordinal small-limit palace with declared LiChun year policy and actual geocentric target seven bodies / four-extra models. Omit for natal only; no implicit today, full classical temporal judgement or event probability.
analysis_datetime.title: Analysis Datetime

birth_clock_basis.description: Confirmed basis of the supplied birth clock label: civil uses birth_timezone; local_mean_solar (LMT) or local_apparent_solar (LAT) uses longitude and modeled UT1/TT with birth_timezone omitted.
birth_clock_basis.title: Birth Clock Basis

birth_microsecond.description: Explicit fraction of the recorded birth second. Preserved in the physical instant and solar-hour calculation; datetime resolution does not certify source-clock or astronomical accuracy.
birth_microsecond.title: Birth Microsecond

birth_second.description: Recorded birth second (0..59), if known. Omitted seconds use the start of the supplied minute; this does not certify exact recording precision. Leap-second labels are not represented.
birth_second.title: Birth Second

birth_timezone.description: Birth timezone (IANA name or UTC offset). Optional: when omitted, FateBridge may resolve it from a supported birth_place. Western charts and timing reject an unresolved civil timezone; coordinates alone do not establish a zone. Supply UTC explicitly when that is the confirmed recorded basis. Place inference does not certify historical clock accuracy.
birth_timezone.title: Birth Timezone

gender.description: 性别（可选，仅用于结果标识；西方星盘计算不使用性别）。接受此字段是为了让同一套出生信息可以原样喂给八字/紫微/星盘等工具，避免批量调用时'有的工具收、有的不收'造成的反复试错。
gender.title: Gender

guolao_month_basis.description: Optional Guolao monthly-limit research policy; requires analysis_datetime. jie_month uses calculated Jie boundaries with Yin=month 1; chinese_lunar_utc8 uses regular Chinese lunar month numbers on UTC+08 civil dates and leaves intercalary birth/target months unassigned. Neither mapping is certified by the cited edition. The annual small limit keeps its declared LiChun year policy. Omit to leave the monthly layer unrequested.
guolao_month_basis.title: Guolao Month Basis

guolao_seasonal_anchor_policy.description: Optional Guolao anchor policy. term_instants preserves v7. source_solar_days_winter_exclusive/inclusive require use_true_solar_time=true or an explicit LAT input: use the same Sun/UT1 apparent-solar day, include the whole Major Cold, summer-solstice and Minor Heat days, and exclude/include the winter-solstice day. These explicit v8 hypotheses do not adjudicate historical day boundaries or predictive validity; numerical ambiguity and model changes error without fallback.
guolao_seasonal_anchor_policy.title: Guolao Seasonal Anchor Policy

house_system.description: Optional offline house system override; if omitted, FateBridge keeps each chart variant's historical default. Accepts SE letters, keys, or integer codes 0..8 (0=whole_sign, 1=Alcabitus, 2=Regiomontanus, 3=Placidus, 4=Koch, 5=Vehlow Equal, 6=Polich Page, 7=Sripati, 8=equal_mc). Explicit values must be integer codes 0..8 or supported offline house letters/names (W, B, R, P, K, V, T, S, D); boolean, floating-point, blank and unsupported values are rejected.
house_system.title: House System

use_true_solar_time.description: Rebase the birth clock onto true solar time (longitude + equation of time). Default OFF: western astrology conventionally casts on the recorded civil (zone) clock time. Set true to align the western chart with the BaZi engine's apparent-solar instant. Guolao and Indian charts preserve the recorded civil instant and report the solar clock separately.
use_true_solar_time.title: Use True Solar Time

zodiac_type.description: Optional offline zodiac override ('Tropic' or 'Sidereal'); if omitted, FateBridge keeps each chart variant's historical default.
zodiac_type.title: Zodiac Type

input.title: AstroGuolaoRequest
